title: PBA: Hot-shooting Ginebra clobbers San Miguel to close in on semis
summary: A hot-shooting Barangay Ginebra pushed the San Miguel Beermen to the brink of elimination in the PBA 50 Governors' Cup on Friday at the Ninoy Aquino Stadium.
